title: abelmoschus officinalis
intro: Abelmoschus officinalis, commonly known as Kuan Yin or Chinese hibiscus, is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Abelmoschus officinalis include cardiotonic, diuretic, and anti-diabetic effects, as well as its potential to stimulate digestive function and protect against liver damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
